# Not in Whatsable

These do not exist in the app or the MCP server. Say so plainly, and offer the closest thing.

## Assign a conversation to a person

There is no assignee. Route with a label on the contact (`add_contact_label`) and limit members to numbers or labels in Team > Edit access; leave a note for a teammate with `add_conversation_note`.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment

## Close or archive a conversation

There is no closed state. Mark it read with `set_conversation_unread`, or label it (for example "Done") with `add_contact_label`.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment

## WhatsApp Flows (forms inside WhatsApp)

Whatsable does not send Flows. Use a template with buttons, or ask the questions in the chat.

## WhatsApp voice or video calls

Whatsable does not place or receive WhatsApp calls. Calls on a number shared with the WhatsApp Business app stay on the phone.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/whatsapp-business-app
